c_from_a_city.text: He came from the east, from somewhere with a working hospital — a city that still runs.

c_same_makers.text: Whoever marked him also made our crates and our records. Cistern 9 and his city share an owner.

c_photo_made.text: The photograph was never taken. Something made it — and made it of me.

c_cisterns_city.text: The cisterns belong to the city. It kept us to spend us, on a schedule; MOTHER has been refusing the schedule for thirty years.

c_mother_answers.text: MOTHER has been answering someone outside for years — and the answer has always been no.

c_same_water.text: Shale's water is run from the same network that feeds the Cistern — by someone who changes the schedule from far away.

c_stranger_route.text: He came west through Shale with nothing left to trade but a ring, and went to the Rust Dogs on purpose.

c_list_of_names.text: The map is a list of people, with places and dates, that someone paid men to stop him carrying west. He carried it to us anyway.

c_held_at_a_number.text: Shale is not short of water. It is being held at a number, by a schedule somebody east writes.

c_same_hand_everywhere.text: The Cistern's records, the pump manual and the Dry Wells log are all kept in one hand. One keeper.

c_fed_from_outside.text: The Cistern was built to be collected. Its water comes from outside, and so, one day, will its people's orders.

c_dead_numbers.text: The Sink's drowned go on living in the city's file: their numbers come up the stair each spring and are sold to people who need to be someone the lens has not seen.

c_rev_last_day.text: The stranger walked out of the city's highest house with twelve faces under his coat, and somebody at the gate already knew to wait for him on the road.

c_static_source.text: The city reads itself its own file on the lamp wire every night at two; a kiosk spliced to it sells the names as fortunes, and a girl who slept against a lift shaft says them as prophecy. Whoever listens right is a forecast.

c_photo_forecast.text: The photograph is a forecast: a portrait of who the file expects me to become, rendered, not taken.

c_crown_sold.text: The Crown is selling itself downriver: the bridge's near end and the Committee's forecasts both go to the Concern by the Long Night, by the same house.

c_cal_future.text: The date on the photograph is the city's year forty-nine, not ours: nineteen years from now. The picture is of a day that has not happened yet.

c_ar_refusals.text: Three times the city ordered the Cistern's people out to it, and three times MOTHER said no and thanked it. A fourth order is written and waiting. Nobody at home knows.

c_ca_for_you.text: The Court is clearing an old woman out of the copy room to make chambers for me, nineteen years before I am due to sit in them.

c_dr_fires.text: The Ring's fires are its evictions. The towers that burn are chalked first, emptied by the fire, and cut for steel; nobody inside the Wall counts the dead, because nobody inside the Wall counts the Ring.

c_dr_road.text: The Crown's road to the Docks is being built out of the Ring's burned towers: House Vane buys the steel by the ton for the near end of the bridge, and does not ask how it came down.

c_hs_robbed.text: Six East did not fall. It was robbed: its pillars cut for a quarter's tonnage on a written order, with eleven people beyond them.

c_hs_parts.text: The Weighhouse grades debtors for parts and sends them up the hill asleep. The boots come home. Clinic service is being taken apart.

c_hs_toll_paper.text: The Toll is Halcyon's paper. The guild takes the Concern's scrip at par and gives the Skirts six to one; the spread is the guild's tithe on every miner's savings.

c_hs_window.text: The Window reaches into everything it fits and everything it sells: it prices bread by your debt and switches off the arm it put on you. Its chrome works for it first.

c_rc_watch.text: The band at Kettle comes along the rails on a handcar from the west, on nights the stationmaster at Four Ways releases the section to them himself: a halt's own watch, on the Junction's token.

c_rc_watch_tag.text: The brass tag in the blind at Kettle is West Halt's watch, number four, missing from its peg. The band at Kettle is West Halt's own watch.

c_rc_marked.text: The stationmaster at Four Ways reads the through's manifests off his wire and ticks the cars that will be opened at Kettle.

c_rc_why.text: What is taken at Kettle feeds the halts that through-running has starved. The Concern's freight runs past them, and its tins come back to them by night.

c_rc_stock.text: The last car opened at Kettle carried people, and the people are in West Halt's water tower.

c_rc_leashed.text: Dorcas did not die. Her board was switched off from far away, the night after the yard said no to the Concern.

c_rc_east.text: East Halt's keeper is loosening the east length herself, a joint at a time, to throw the through off the rails at her own halt.

c_ds_kai.text: Kai Tanoa did not drown of the sea. He drowned freeing his net from a leaking joint on the Rigs' old export line, in water the oil had blacked so he could not see his hand.

c_ds_guild_line.text: The guild opened Hum's old line to its tank at Blackcap and loads Hum's oil at night for its own account; the line leaks the difference under Gull Stilts, and Hum's keeper thinks his platform is dying.

c_ds_sold.text: Mateo Ibarra never went in the water. The guild's press took him on Rui Sousa's word and paid Rui with his boat, and set the Curlew adrift so the Book would write him drowned.

c_ds_false_light.text: Somebody on the shore cuts Lean's gas line in fog and hangs a false light on the Jesty, and the guild's barges steer onto the roof for it. Only guild barges, and only since the fish died.

c_dk_override.text: The box weighed more than twice its bill, and somebody overrode Crane Six's cutout with the night key to lift it. The spreader could not hold what the cutout was there to refuse.

c_dk_paid.text: Dmytro Lysenko turned the cutout himself, with a key he had cut, on the Bond's night pass, and he was paid for it in medicine for his girl.

c_dk_skim.text: The Concern bills its boxes at half their weight and the guild never weighs the through. The Bond pays a night hand to lift what the crane's cutout would refuse, so that nothing ever shows.

c_dk_crewed.text: Under the Harbour Act the Hulls are vessels in port, and every one of them has a crew aboard. A lease cannot move a crewed ship; only her master can, or the court on proof she is abandoned.

c_tm_told.text: Nothing in the taken could have told the Clean where they were, and the Clean knew the hour. Somebody at Number Four tells them who is coming over the col.

c_tm_radio.text: The nights before the takings are the nights the winding house's set said VISITORS. It is the boss's own set.

c_tm_arrangement.text: The free pit is free by arrangement: the Concern pays double for its tin through the guild, and takes a name a season off its path.

c_tm_parts.text: The people the Concern asks Number Four for are graded by what is in them. They do not go back to the Window. They go up to the Clinic floors.

c_nw_lie.text: Ashby has never been full. Its keepers have wedged the gauge so the city's controller reads a lake that is not there.

c_nw_why.text: The keepers hold the Water at the sixth mark because the dam is cracked and would not hold it higher. Above the sixth mark it fails, and everything down the river with it.

c_nw_sink.text: Every spring Ashby comes in short of a schedule written for a full lake, and every spring the city makes the shortfall good with the Sink's pumps. The keepers' lie is one reason the Sink drowns.

c_nw_marker.text: The mark-cutter at Sawtown's boom is Sigrun Brandvold: she cuts her own family's marks off their logs and puts the Bottoms' hook on them.

c_nw_why_marks.text: The money from the Ridge's re-marked logs goes to the Bottoms, and Rufino Huaman gives it to his daughter and Mikkel Brandvold's child, whom the Ridge will not own.

c_nw_widowmaker.text: Nobody on the Bottoms dropped anything on Mikkel Brandvold. His father sent him up to fell a leaner in the rain, and the tree split and came back on him.

c_nw_kennel.text: The Patience's load is twelve hound controllers from the Concern, consigned to the guild's floor at the city's Docks.
